bullets.text: In Chennai, a young man tragically died after losing control of his bike and falling into stagnant rainwater.
Severe cyclonic storm Murasu uprooted 12 trees across Chennai, damaging houses and vehicles while inundating several roads.
Thiruvallur district officials suspended 61 Tasmac employees who protested by refusing to open liquor shops over the empty bottle collection rule.
Plastic garbage and waste accumulated in the Peli Amman Temple tank in Taramani, Chennai, causing a severe foul smell.
An ambulance got stuck in heavy traffic near Kamatchi Hospital on the Pallavaram-Thuraipakkam Radial Road in Pallikaranai due to rain and office hours.
Sewage vehicle owners staged a protest by parking their vehicles inside the Gummidipoondi Panchayat Union Office.
Agriculture department officials in Tiruttani advised farmers on methods to remove stagnant rainwater from fields to protect crops.
Liquor sales were barred within 5km of the Andhra Pradesh border in Tiruvallur ahead of the Chittoor polls.
Vultr plans to build 1 GW of AI compute capacity in India by 2029, placing Chennai at the center of this expansion.
Corning expanded its Pune optical manufacturing and began its Chennai cover-glass plant for the AI data center market.
MeitY unveiled the DEPA framework handbook to unlock secure data sharing for AI training across institutions.
